# Statements osgo (open-steamgate's Go runtime) does not compile yet, as
# the exact diagnostic osgo prints after "NOT_COMPILED in X=>M (file:line): ",
# one per line. A NOT_COMPILED row with exactly that diagnostic
# does not fail the osgo job; every other non-passing row does
# (a wrong value, an error, an unknown NOT_COMPILED). Remove a line as soon as
# open-steamgate compiles it (the job prints which lines matched nothing).
# The runtime behaviour itself is pinned on A4H; see the inbox/issue noted.
unknown method IPOW
conversion x -> int8
conversion int8 -> x
# Split chunks require dynamic class and method names (ABAP 7.02). The pinned
# Go frontend accepts only static CALL METHOD; OSD runs these same assertions.
CALL METHOD form: CALL METHOD (lv_cls)=>(lv_meth) EXPORTING p0 = s0 RECEIVING rv = s0.
